theme_and_archetype.theme: Light Theme (Default) with Dark Mode Toggle
theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a 'modern minimalist with professional/corporate aesthetic', the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype emphasizes authority, clarity, and function-first design. It avoids visual clutter, utilizing deep blacks, stark whites, and highly vibrant functional accents (signal colors for finances).

typography.notes: Never use Inter or generic default fonts for headings. Use Outfit to give a sharp, geometric, and corporate look. Tight letter-spacing for large text is mandatory.

color_palette.rules: All greys must be tinted with blue (Slate). Ensure 4.5:1 text contrast. Do not use pure #000000 or #808080.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 extensively to separate sections and create an uncluttered, corporate look.

general.sidebar_layout: Sidebar fixed w-64, Main content margin-left 64 (md/lg viewports).

cards.style: Flat Solid with 1px border. No shadows in light mode to keep it crisp. In dark mode, use subtle shadow to add depth if needed.
cards.classes: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6

headers_and_nav.classes: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border-b border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-800/50 backdrop-saturate-150

tables_and_lists.classes: border-collapse styles. Subtle borders separating rows, no heavy alternating background colors.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background or text color smoothly (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and list items.
motion_and_interactions.charts: Recharts tooltips and bars/lines should have gentle ease-in animations.

components_and_libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for primary icons, Regular for standard UI)

media_and_assets.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons heavily for all features, stats, and empty states. Do not use placeholder images.

auth_background.description: Abstract architectural geometric pattern for Login/Register split-screen background.

user_avatar_placeholder.description: Professional avatar for the top navbar profile dropdown.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, form inputs, menus, and significant UI components. Format: kebab-case (e.g., login-submit-button).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text, especially within cards and badges, passes contrast ratios.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: react-router-dom, @reduxjs/toolkit, react-redux, recharts, @phosphor-icons/react, sonner, clsx, tailwind-merge
Initialize Shadcn UI and install necessary primitive components
Configure Tailwind CSS with the provided color palette (use Slate for neutral grays) and add the fonts via CSS imports
Build the Sidebar and Top Navbar layout first. Ensure it collapses cleanly on mobile.
Use Phosphor icons heavily: TrendUp, TrendDown, Wallet, ChartPie, ShieldCheck, etc.
Implement the dashboard using Grid Mode B (Control Room grid)
For Dark Mode, use the 'dark' tailwind class and toggle via Redux or LocalStorage.
Do NOT use HTML inputs for Date or Select; use Shadcn equivalents.
All components must be functional, and API integrations with FastAPI should be properly wired up or clearly structured with Redux Thunks/RTK Query.
